question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
-- Final answer: count distinct legislators for each years_elapsed
WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM male_la_legislators)
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
year_series AS (
    SELECT UNNEST(generate_series(1800, 2025)) AS year_val
),
term_years AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        ys.year_val AS dec31_year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(ft.first_term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS first_term_year,
        ys.year_val - CAST(SUBSTR(ft.first_term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS years_elapsed
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN year_series ys
    WHERE 
        lt.term_start <= CAST(ys.year_val AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31'
        AND lt.term_end >= CAST(ys.year_val AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31'
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, dec31_year, years_elapsed
    FROM term_years
    WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS num_legislators
FROM filtered
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
